description: MainActivity.java for an Android Wearable app demonstrating ambient mode support, using Handlers and Alarms for screen updates, managing UI components, and handling ambient lifecycle events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Wearable activity managing ambient and active modes with screen update logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and configures ambient mode and layout inflation.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, triggers display refresh.

methods.name: onEnterAmbient
methods.description: Prepares UI for ambient mode, disables anti-aliasing, sets colors.

methods.name: onUpdateAmbient
methods.description: Updates UI in ambient mode, triggers display refresh.

methods.name: onExitAmbient
methods.description: Restores UI for active mode, re-enables anti-aliasing, cancels alarms.

methods.name: refreshDisplayAndSetNextUpdate
methods.description: Updates screen data and schedules next update based on mode.

methods.name: loadDataAndUpdateScreen
methods.description: Loads current time and mode info, updates UI components.
